title: Malicious code in hs-framework (npm)
description: The hs-framework npm package declares a dependency on a tarball hosted at an external HTTPS URL rather than a versioned registry package. This tarball can be changed at any time by whoever controls the storage bucket, allowing arbitrary code execution during npm install via lifecycle scripts. The package itself is a minimal stub, with the dependency URL being the main attack surface. This setup enables supply chain compromise through dynamic, unpinned, and unverified code fetched during installation.
